hook: Tap anything at a small town's harvest festival night, from the Ferris wheel to the plane overhead, to meet the 93 people whose work made it happen, and light a lantern for each of the 14 career clusters.
outcome: Name the 14 career clusters and give examples of occupations in each, see how several clusters work together behind one everyday thing, and compare each cluster's ways in by entry-level education, pay and job outlook
sources: Career clusters and their one-line definitions: Advance CTE, Career Clusters Framework (2024), The Cluster Defined: https://careertech.org/career-clusters/

Typical entry-level education, job outlook 2025-35 and number of jobs 2025: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics, Occupational Outlook Handbook, 2025-35 edition, one profile per career (listed in sources.md): https://www.bls.gov/ooh/
Median pay for each job: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics, Occupational Employment and Wage Statistics, May 2025 (national)
